The stone stockpile is a construct used to store [[stone block]]s and [[marble block]]s. It's required in order to later process these blocks at the [[stone cutter]] or [[stone cutter II]] into [[A piece of stone|stone pieces]] and [[A piece of marble|marble pieces]], respectively.

It's important, as {{item|zombie}}s can deliver blocks there. Either they mine them, or they transport them from one stockpile to another.

== Note ==
*Only 6 blocks of stone or marble can be stored in a stockpile at a time.
